name: rfid-tigertag
title: TigerTag Filament Tag
description: Reads TigerTag filament tags (open NTAG21x, no key required) and decodes the physical filament data - colors, diameter, nozzle and bed temperatures, drying temperature, and weight - into the shared rfid_data.json. The brand and material are stored on a TigerTag as numeric ids whose human-name tables are GPLv3, so this decoder ships no GPL table and does not read them; the brand shows as TigerTag and the material as NONE. The product id is surfaced as the SKU. Works on the standard NTAG reader (no key, no reader change). Installs the RFID Spool Reader automatically. Read-only. Testing channel.
tagline: Decode open TigerTag NTAG spools (colors, temps, diameter, weight).
author: bespoked
